name: web-artifacts-builder

summary.en: Anthropic’s tooling for multi-component claude.ai HTML artifacts built with React, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, bundled into a single file.
summary.zh: Anthropic 出品，用 React、Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn/ui 构建多组件的 claude.ai HTML Artifact，并打包成单个文件。

upstreamDescription: Suite of tools for creating elaborate, multi-component claude.ai HTML artifacts using modern frontend web technologies (React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui). Use for complex artifacts requiring state management, routing, or shadcn/ui components - not for simple single-file HTML/JSX artifacts.
